title: Ἐθνικά / Ethnica / «Этника»; unit: entries on Hellenistic city foundations (Alexandreiai, Antiocheiai, Seleukeiai…)
author: Stephanus of Byzantium (surviving in an epitome, traditionally Hermolaus')
genre: Geographical-grammatical lexicon of place names and ethnic adjectives
size: Epitome of 60 books. Meineke's edition is about 715 pp. Estimate: over 3,000 entries.
edition: A. Meineke 1849 (PD). M. Billerbeck et al., CFHB 43/1–5 (2006–2017, Greek with German translation; in copyright).
ru_evidence: Only letter E (M. M. Kholod, Клио 2(21), 2003; online at vostlit.info) and Pontic/Caucasian excerpts in Latyshev's collection. No complete Russian translation.
en_evidence: ToposText work 241: 'A few entries… have been translated by Brady Kiesling'; the rest is Greek only. No complete English translation found.
value: Preserves thousands of fragments of lost historians and geographers (Hecataeus, Theopompus, Alexander Polyhistor). Key for historical geography, ethnography, epigraphy and Hellenistic foundations; the Alexander material fits the editor's expertise.
ai_feasibility: medium: formulaic entries are easy. Morphology of ethnic forms, corrupt quotations and source identification need an expert. Billerbeck's German is an ideal cross-check.
pilot_unit: About 40 entries on Alexandreia, Antiocheia, Seleukeia, Apameia, Laodikeia, etc. (estimate 5k words). Alternative: the whole of letter Δ.
